# MatchMind

> MatchMind is a free AI football intelligence web application for World Cup 2026 fans. Users ask natural-language questions; MatchMind classifies intent, queries a MongoDB Atlas football database via MCP tools, and returns analyst-grade insights — powered by Gemini and Google Cloud Agent Builder.

MatchMind is a Next.js web app with a fan-facing agent and an optional admin agent for curated data updates. It is not a live FIFA broadcast feed, not a betting product, and not a generic chatbot.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://app.matchmind.xyz/): Product overview, features, and FAQ
- [About](https://about.matchmind.xyz/): Application purpose and how MatchMind works
- [Football Intelligence Agent](https://agent.matchmind.xyz/): Ask World Cup 2026 stats, predictions, fantasy, tactics, and history
- [Sign in](https://auth.matchmind.xyz/signin): Optional account access for history and personalization
- [Privacy](https://app.matchmind.xyz/privacy): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://app.matchmind.xyz/terms): Terms of service
- [Architecture](https://app.matchmind.xyz/docs/architecture): Technical overview of the agent pipeline and stack
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/mojeebdev/matchmind): Source code, setup, and README

## What We Do Not Do

MatchMind does not provide:
- Live FIFA broadcast scores or official real-time match feeds
- Betting advice or gambling recommendations
- Guaranteed match outcome predictions
